children.name: Desc

children.text: 1. Layout: 500px Cozy Lake Modal with cream background (#FFF8EC), 36px radius, and 2px track border.
2. Header: Coral Rod square card (92px), Enchant Preview mint chip, Fredoka One title, and Level transition row.
3. Table Grid: 4 columns with Before (+3) in subtle Sky Blue (#F0F8FD) and After (+4) in subtle Mint (#F0FAF5).
4. Gain Column: High-contrast Mint Green pill badges (+1%, +0.01, +0.2%) for immediate reward readability.
5. Footer: Sand-colored footer (#F3E9D8) with Cancel ghost button and 1.4k Gold lip coin button.
6. Strict Compliance: Zero checkmarks, zero bullets, and zero emojis used.
